Washington.authority: Washington State Gambling Commission / tribal operators
Washington.note: Twenty-nine tribal casino destinations. The regulator states 23 tribes operate 29 casinos; its current rendered directory shows 28 entries, with operating Shoalwater Bay Casino reconciled separately.

Oregon.authority: Oregon State Police / National Indian Gaming Commission / tribal operators
Oregon.note: Ten current tribal casino destinations under app scope, including two Ko-Kwel properties and two Three Rivers properties. Burns Paiute's Old Camp Casino remains closed.
